# Additions to Daniel Chapter 1 (Prayer of Azariah & Song of the Three) — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus (Theodotion recension), Additions to Daniel 1 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADD_001_page_001.jpg

---

*[Addition 1: Inserted between Daniel 3:23 and 3:24. The Prayer of Azariah (vv. Pr.Az.1–21) is a penitential prayer from within the furnace. The Song of the Three (vv. 29–68 in Theodotion) is the cosmic Benedicite hymn.]*

---

### The Prayer of Azariah

**Pr.Az.1** And they walked in the midst of the fire, singing hymns to God and blessing the Lord.

**Pr.Az.2** Then Azariah stood and prayed in this manner, and opening his mouth in the midst of the fire he said:

**Pr.Az.3** "Blessed are you, O Lord, God of our fathers, worthy of praise and exaltation above all forever;

**Pr.Az.4** and blessed is your holy and glorious name, and worthy of highest praise and exaltation above all forever.

**Pr.Az.5** Righteous are you in all that you have done to us; all your works are true and your ways straight, and all your judgments are truth.

**Pr.Az.6** True judgments you have executed in all that you have brought upon us and upon Jerusalem, the holy city of our fathers, for in truth and in justice you have brought all these things upon us because of our sins.

**Pr.Az.7** For we have sinned and acted lawlessly in departing from you.

**Pr.Az.8** In everything we have sinned and have not listened to your commandments;

**Pr.Az.9** we have not kept them and have not done as you commanded us, that things might go well for us.

**Pr.Az.10** And all that you have brought upon us and all that you have done to us, you have done in just judgment.

**Pr.Az.11** You have given us into the hands of lawless enemies, hateful rebels, and an unjust king — the most evil in all the earth.

**Pr.Az.12** And now we cannot even open our mouths; shame and reproach have come upon your servants and upon those who worship you.

**Pr.Az.13** Do not give us up forever, for the sake of your name; do not annul your covenant,

**Pr.Az.14** and do not withdraw your mercy from us — for the sake of Abraham your beloved, and Isaac your servant, and Israel your holy one,

**Pr.Az.15** to whom you promised to multiply their descendants as the stars of heaven and as the sand on the shore of the sea.

**Pr.Az.16** For, Lord, we have become fewer than all the nations, and are humbled this day throughout all the earth because of our sins.

**Pr.Az.17** At this time there is no prince or prophet or leader, no burnt offering or sacrifice or oblation or incense, no place to offer first-fruits before you and to find mercy.

**Pr.Az.18** But with a contrite soul and a humble spirit, may we be accepted.

**Pr.Az.19** As with burnt offerings of rams and bulls, and with tens of thousands of fat lambs, so let our sacrifice be before you this day, and may it be wholly pleasing before you; for there is no shame for those who trust in you.

**Pr.Az.20** And now we follow you with our whole heart; we fear you and seek your face.

**Pr.Az.21** Do not put us to shame, but deal with us according to your gentleness and according to the abundance of your mercy.

**Pr.Az.22** Deliver us in accordance with your wonderful works, and bring glory to your name, O Lord.

**Pr.Az.23** Let all who do evil to your servants be put to shame; let them be disgraced and stripped of all their power, and let their strength be broken.

**Pr.Az.24** Let them know that you alone are the Lord God, glorious over all the earth."

**Pr.Az.25** And the servants of the king who had thrown them in did not stop feeding the furnace with naphtha, pitch, tow, and brushwood,

**Pr.Az.26** and the flame shot out above the furnace forty-nine cubits,

**Pr.Az.27** and it spread out and burned those Chaldeans whom it found around the furnace.

**Pr.Az.28** But the angel of the Lord came down into the furnace to be with Azariah and his companions, and he drove the fiery flame out of the furnace,

**Pr.Az.29** and made the inside of the furnace as if a moist, whistling breeze were blowing through it; and the fire did not touch them at all, nor cause them pain, nor trouble them in any way.

---

### The Song of the Three Young Men (Benedicite)

**Song.1** Then the three, as with one mouth, praised and glorified and blessed God in the furnace, saying:

**Song.2** "Blessed are you, O Lord, God of our fathers, and worthy of highest praise and exaltation above all forever;

**Song.3** and blessed is your holy and glorious name, worthy of highest praise and exaltation above all forever.

**Song.4** Blessed are you in the temple of your holy glory, and worthy of highest praise and exaltation above all forever.

**Song.5** Blessed are you upon the throne of your kingdom, and worthy of highest praise and exaltation above all forever.

**Song.6** Blessed are you who look upon the depths and sit enthroned upon the cherubim, and worthy of praise and exaltation above all forever.

**Song.7** Blessed are you in the firmament of heaven, and worthy of highest praise and glorification forever.

**Song.8** Bless the Lord, all you works of the Lord; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.9** Bless the Lord, you angels of the Lord; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.10** Bless the Lord, you heavens; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.11** Bless the Lord, all you waters above the heavens; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.12** Bless the Lord, all you hosts of the Lord; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.13** Bless the Lord, sun and moon; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.14** Bless the Lord, stars of heaven; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.15** Bless the Lord, every shower and dew; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.16** Bless the Lord, all you winds; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.17** Bless the Lord, fire and heat; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.18** Bless the Lord, winter cold and summer heat; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.19** Bless the Lord, dews and hoarfrosts; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.20** Bless the Lord, frost and cold; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.21** Bless the Lord, ice and snow; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.22** Bless the Lord, nights and days; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.23** Bless the Lord, light and darkness; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.24** Bless the Lord, lightning and clouds; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.25** Let the earth bless the Lord; let it sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.26** Bless the Lord, mountains and hills; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.27** Bless the Lord, all things that grow upon the earth; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.28** Bless the Lord, seas and rivers; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.29** Bless the Lord, springs; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.30** Bless the Lord, you whales and all things that move in the waters; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.31** Bless the Lord, all you birds of heaven; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.32** Bless the Lord, all you wild beasts and cattle; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.33** Bless the Lord, you sons of men; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.34** Bless the Lord, O Israel; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.35** Bless the Lord, you priests of the Lord; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.36** Bless the Lord, you servants of the Lord; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.37** Bless the Lord, spirits and souls of the righteous; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.38** Bless the Lord, you who are holy and humble of heart; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever.

**Song.39** Bless the Lord, Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael; sing his praise and exalt him above all forever. For he has rescued us from Hades and saved us from the hand of death, and delivered us from the midst of the burning fiery furnace; from the very midst of the fire he has delivered us.

**Song.40** Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever.

**Song.41** Bless all who fear the Lord, the God of gods; sing his praise and give thanks to him, for his steadfast love endures forever."
